description: Use when you need the latest posts or headlines from a site, blog, newsroom, podcast or subreddit: give a feed URL or just the site URL (the RSS/Atom feed is auto-discovered from the page) and get normalized items with title, link, publish date (ISO 8601), author, summary, image and categories, newest first as the feed lists them. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
